title: Bias-Variance Tradeoff
prompt:
Derive the **Bias-Variance Tradeoff** decomposition for Mean Squared Error:

$$\mathbb{E}\left[(y - \hat{f}(x))^2\right] = \left(\text{Bias}[\hat{f}(x)]\right)^2 + \text{Var}[\hat{f}(x)] + \sigma_\epsilon^2$$

resources.title: Lecture 12: Bias-Variance Tradeoff (Cornell CS4780)
resources.why: Derives the decomposition into bias, variance and noise.
